# netbox_front_port_template (Data Source)

Retrieves a single front port template from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_front_port_template" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

output "front_port_template_id" {
  value = data.netbox_front_port_template.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the front port template.

### Optional

- `device_type_id` (Number) The ID of the device type associated with the front port template.
- `module_type_id` (Number) The ID of the module type associated with the front port template.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) The color of the front port template.
- `created` (String) The created of the front port template.
- `description` (String) A description of the front port template.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `label` (String) The label of the front port template.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the front port template.
- `positions` (Number) The positions of the front port template.
- `type` (String) The type of the front port template.
